info.desc: America is a studio album by American electronic musician Dan Deacon, released August 27, 2012 on Domino Records.The album cover is a photo of Lake Placid.America was recorded using both electronic sounds and live recordingsAn anechoic chamber was built in Baltimore to record the orchestral track "Rail."The reason Deacon decided to incorporate live instruments onto the album was that Deacon felt that electronic beats were limited by its lack of flaws and that he wanted the "slight imperfection in timing" human musicians have.
